alignmentCheck.method: analytic: ortho and DTM share one equirectangular grid; crop placed from the site's own DTM crop geometry

diagnosticFixedSunNcc.note: fixed-sun hillshade vs photo; biased by illumination mismatch, not applied

renderNote: Raw DN linearly stretched (1st-99th percentile) to 8-bit for display; not radiometrically calibrated to I/F reflectance (the label's SCALING_FACTOR/OFFSET do that, but a display texture doesn't need it).
